title: Read that left side again. Let it sink in. It hurts, but it’s the truth that will finally set you free. ⛓️💥
paragraphs: Read that left side again. Let it sink in. It hurts, but it’s the truth that will finally set you free. ⛓️💥

Stop auditioning for a role in someone’s life that they never intended to cast you in. The hardest pill to swallow is realizing you were fighting for a seat at a table where you were only ever tolerated, never celebrated. Their inability to see your worth does not decrease your value. You are a Gospel Warrior, and your identity isn't anchored in who left; it's anchored in Who stayed.
Break the chains of people-pleasing. You are already chosen.
Bible Verse: 👇 "Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you..." - Isaiah 43:4 (NIV)
If this spoke to your soul, drop an "AMEN" below and follow @[iamgospelwarrior for daily battles against the lies of the enemy. ⚔️🔥
